source: Starting point, not official. Rig: Fender Hot Rod DeVille + Visual Sound Jekyll & Hyde overdrive (MXR Micro Amp for leads) on Is This It / Room on Fire (Mixdown, Gearnews). Amp EQ from Killer Rig 'Reptilia': gain 6-7, treble 8, mids 4, bass 5, no reverb listed. FD TWIN-R stands in for the Hot Rod (Fender, has a MID knob); TS Drive stands in for the Jekyll side. Drive values are estimates.
